svg.title: Krupakar S Bilichod: Cyber Security, GRC, ISO 27001, SOC 2, DPDP. A tree of his work: Zlang, manjim, delbina, Hasfragis (team project) and BitPillars (game studio).
svg.text: Cyber Security · GRC · ISO 27001 · SOC 2 · DPDP · B.Tech '27
A language and console that puts common security tools behind one readable syntax.
Background jobs, a scope check on every network command, and signed evidence on lockdown.
A zero-dependency GRC and IT audit CLI with checks mapped to ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
Hygiene score, a risk register with DPDP Act flags, and sealed reports that show any change.
Cuts the token cost of long AI chats and agents with cache-friendly compression.
Secret redaction and a compaction log. delbina-sum, a small summarizer model, in progress.
A digital forensics toolkit that makes evidence tamper-evident and checkable.
File hashes, a Merkle root, a signed custody ledger and an incident timeline.
Tiny pixel games, free to play in the browser on phone or desktop.
Ten games so far, from a gravity puzzle to a game in the dark. krupakarsb.github.io/bitpillars
